## About Hawaii Fresh Juice

Hawaii Fresh Juice (also known as Hawaii Juices) is a certified Omani juice brand founded in March 2024 by Yasir Arafath (CEO & Founder). It was inspired by a new beginning in Muscat after the pandemic — the founder's vision for natural, trustworthy juices grew from small restaurant-kitchen experiments into a certified Omani brand.

Mission: make fresh, high-quality fruit juices accessible and affordable for everyone.

The brand offers 100% natural, farm-to-bottle fruit juices sourced from carefully selected fruits at local Omani markets. By sourcing this way, Hawaii supports regional Omani agriculture and the international farmers who supply these community markets.

Brand promise: "We believe in keeping it real." — honest, fresh juice made for everyday enjoyment.

Slogan: "Taste Oman in every sip."

## Products

Every product is 100% organic, contains no artificial preservatives or additives, and comes in a 200 mL bottle priced at 0.200 OMR. Nutrition values are per 200 mL bottle.

### Ginger Orange — Signature
A bright, golden crush of premium sun-ripened oranges with a hint of local ginger. Rich in Vitamin C; supports immunity and offers anti-inflammatory benefits.
- Calories: 102.45
- Ingredients: Fresh Orange Fruit, Organic Ginger, Natural Sweetener, Natural Citric Acid
- Nutrition: Total Fat 0g, Sucrose 2.65mg, Fructose 1.75mg, Glucose 1.72mg, Dietary Fiber 0.13mg, Sodium 0.24mg
- URL: https://hawaiioman.com/products/ginger-orange

### Ball Grape — Seasonal
Deep, rich, and naturally sweet grapes harvested from high-altitude crisp terraces.
- Calories: 268.45
- Ingredients: Fresh Grape Fruit, Natural Citric Acid, Natural Sweetener, Natural Preservatives
- Nutrition: Total Fat 0g, Sucrose 5.83mg, Fructose 5.0mg, Glucose 5.21mg, Dietary Fiber 0.30mg, Sodium 0.63mg
- URL: https://hawaiioman.com/products/ball-grape

### Pieces Mango — Best Seller
Lusciously sweet and thick mango puree grown organically in tropical regions.

## FAQ

Q: What is Hawaii Fresh Juice?
A: A certified Omani juice brand founded March 2024 by Yasir Arafath, making 100% natural farm-to-bottle fruit juices in Al Wadi Al Kabir, Muscat, Oman.

Q: Are the juices 100% natural?
A: Yes — 100% organic, no artificial preservatives or additives.

Q: What flavors are available?
A: Ginger Orange (signature), Ball Grape (seasonal), Pieces Mango (best seller), Natural Lemon (new). Coming soon: Ice Bounty, Pieces Pineapple.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: 0.200 OMR per 200 mL bottle.

Q: Where can I buy it?
A: The juice bar in Al Wadi Al Kabir, Muscat, and select retailers, groceries and schools across Oman.
